content: Rendering: long statusline output truncates or wraps awkwardly; right side of row shared with system notifications/verbose token counter on narrow terminals; complex ANSI/OSC sequences can garble output when overlapping UI updates; multi-line + escape codes more prone to glitches; escape sequences appearing literally means echo -e failed — use printf '%b'; ANSI bytes must be excluded from any width math; unicode symbols depend on terminal font, and bash string length ops miscount multibyte chars under C locale.
